title: SCNet P0 R06f 800 m/s no-mass-scaling TSSFAC sensitivity
purpose: Test whether the frozen 800 m/s, 0.75 mm R06f response is numerically sensitive to halving TSSFAC from 0.8 to 0.4 while DT2MS remains zero.

provenance.identity_rule: Mesh, coordinates, connectivity, IDs, PIDs, material, EOS, contact, section, boundary conditions, speed, termination, output cards, resource contract and every CONTROL_TIMESTEP field except TSSFAC remain identical to the released Job 72617857 control deck.

symmetry.validity: normal incidence, face-on cube, centered impact only

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_binary_policy: Set NEIPH=6 and explicitly preserve all other R15.0.2 documented Card 1/Card 2 defaults; Card 2 is mandatory.

damage_source.sentinel_policy: absolute value at or above 1e29 is unavailable with a reason, never zero

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_d3part_policy: Explicit NEIPH=6 request is a redundant-channel experiment; full D3PLOT HVAR6 remains authoritative.

paired_experiments.question: Does halving TSSFAC from 0.8 to 0.4 materially change the frozen 800 m/s response without mass scaling?

preregistered_evaluation.primary_comparison: r06f_0800_tssfac04 versus platform Job 72617857 using the frozen diagnostic q tolerances
preregistered_evaluation.support_condition: Target R15.0.2 parses and terminates normally; one-node/32-rank resource identity and required outputs pass; qM/qP/qE absolute differences are each <=0.01 and qV relative difference is <=0.05.
preregistered_evaluation.refute_condition: Parser/runtime/resource failure, missing required output, mass scaling, unexplained invalid data, or any frozen numerical tolerance is exceeded.
preregistered_evaluation.secondary_diagnostics: Energy, negative-volume topology, alive masks, HVAR6 and NCFORC are reported as mechanism evidence and do not replace the primary q gates.
preregistered_evaluation.claim_boundary: A passed timestep comparison is numerical qualification only and does not recover the unavailable formal primary QoI or establish physical validity.

submission_sequence.wave_0_gate: Zero KEY errors, 1 node/32 ranks, normal termination, no mass scaling, run-integrity PASS, readable D3PART/full-D3PLOT HVAR6/NCFORC, and frozen q comparison tolerances against Job 72617857.
submission_sequence.hold_after_wave_0: Do not submit the 2000 m/s control or any treatment until the returned TSSFAC=0.4 diagnostic is audited.
submission_sequence.resource_identity: Use exactly one node, 32 ranks, LS-DYNA R15 MPP double precision, and the same memory settings as Job 72617857.

deferred_not_generated.reason: Hold until the TSSFAC=0.4 numerical comparison passes.

claim_boundary: The resource-matched R06f recanary passed; its formal primary QoI remains unavailable.
This package changes only TSSFAC from 0.8 to 0.4 and keeps DT2MS=0.
INTFOR is not requested; missing evidence is never a zero response.
Static PASS and normal termination do not establish numerical robustness, physical validity, P0/P1 admission, engine fitting, or dataset-label admission.
